issue.title: %auto parity: manual ,x and sase agent restart should follow the live autonomy record

task_type_fields.proposal: Make manual ,x (prepare_kill_and_edit_prompt) and sase agent restart apply the live autonomy record to the relaunched prompt the way plan_agent_restart(follow_live_autonomy=True) does for auto-restart, via the shared rewrite_prompt_from_live_record helper in src/sase/agent/_restart_live_autonomy.py (proposed by sase-1j6.9).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1j6 required that sase agent restart keep today's behavior; changing manual restart semantics is a separate user-facing decision.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1j6.9 (land phase of epic sase-1j6): auto-restart relaunches with follow_live_autonomy=True, but manual ,x and sase agent restart still use the authored prompt, so an A toggle is lost on manual restart.
